drift_demo.distance: Euclidean distance to healthy_gt_90 training centroid

applied_standardized_shift.meaning: controlled operating-setting shift on raw setting columns 1-3

drift_demo.feature_mapping_note: The loader keeps the three operating settings at dimensions 0-2; dimensions 33-35 are engineered baseline deltas, not fan/load settings.

region_map.kde_population: training windows by stage; contours are descriptive, not calibrated boundaries

limitations: Nearest-centroid results are retrieval metrics, not classifier accuracy or calibrated confidence.
Feature-based reason sentences compare normalized sensor RMS/crest statistics with the training reference for the nearest-prototype stage; they are review aids, not causal diagnoses.
FD001 is a single operating-condition subset; the standardized setting shift is a controlled stress test, not an observed field drift event.
KDE/PCA regions are descriptive projections and do not define decision boundaries.
